external_primary_crosschecks.note: Primary paper supports adversarial/pathwise validity with restricted feedback and stochastic sublinear efficiency regret; rates are model-dependent and projection/clipping scope must remain exact.
Primary ACS paper supports adaptive interactive conformal selection with information-control rules and rigorous FDR; no exact power gain is imported here.
Peer-reviewed PMLR paper supports positive-probability nontermination pathology for common fixed-confidence BAI analyses and exponential-tailed wrapper remedies.
Peer-reviewed USENIX source supports defense-adapted attacks bypassing the tested 12 defenses; exact Figure-1 cells are restricted to the tested defense/threat-model pairs.
Peer-reviewed ICLR source supports adaptive prompt injection against trusted monitors and the tested least-suspicious resampling failure mode.
Primary preprint plus author-linked code support contextual-manipulation defense-backfire evidence; this is a threat-model-specific result, not a global SecAlign ordering.
Primary preprint supports large degradation under environmental interference while explicitly leaving component attribution confounded.
Primary paper supports checkpoint/rollback efficiency and overall up-to-71% latency/up-to-70% token reductions; those overall numbers are not attributed to the selector-only ablation.
Peer-reviewed/public-code UQD work supports corrected-archive evaluation, uncertainty-aware archive maintenance, and matched sampling-budget comparisons.
Peer-reviewed e-LOND work supports online FDR control with e-values under arbitrary dependence; transfer to adaptively generated archive candidates requires its own filtration proof.
Primary paper supports the 185-theorem ProofNet evaluation, 100k output-token budget, and matched linear-baseline solve-rate gains across Kimi-K2.5 and Leanstral.

Peer-reviewed Rocket article supports reward-std diagnostics, ImageNet subset adequacy transition around 1/128 in the tested setting, final 1/1024 full-data performance 65.23, and up-to-80x reward-computation acceleration.

Primary SkillBrew paper supports leave-one-out diagnosis and the Table-4/Table-5 objective/edit-operation ablations; no independent reproduction or clearly released official code was identified in this wave.

assessments.rationale: Peer-reviewed method plus official experiment documentation/code now make the intended STL-10 semantic label order recoverable. The released converter still uses unsorted directory enumeration, and no UC8 precomputed embeddings/HDF5 or release asset was found even in the inspected pre-renumbering tree, so exact author-artifact replay remains unavailable.
assessments.tested_scope: Released DriftLens STL-10 same-label blur/domain-shift benchmark construction and code/documentation lineage.
corrections_or_limits: Impose or verify documented class order for regeneration; do not rely on os.listdir ordering.
Missing HDF5/embeddings are a reproducibility gap, not negative evidence about detector quality.
No independent numerical rerun identified; standard use-case accuracy remains window classification rather than chronological alarm performance.

assessments.rationale: Primary 2026 theory directly combines adversarial/pathwise long-run validity under restricted feedback with stochastic efficiency control, and identifies projection/clipping as incompatible with the accounting identity used by the validity proof. Quantitative rates are theorem-level but model-dependent.
assessments.tested_scope: Online conformal subset/threshold selection under the paper's bandit-feedback and stochastic-efficiency assumptions.
corrections_or_limits: Do not turn O(1/sqrt(T)) tracking and model-specific regret rates into a universal online-control rate.
Boundary actions can be costly; no target-only utility/no-negative-transfer theorem is established.
Research-loop transfer is a hypothesis, not direct empirical evidence.

assessments.rationale: Primary ACS work provides a rigorous information-access protocol for adaptive interactive conformal selection with FDR control while permitting partial data reuse and updates. This is strong statistical-validity evidence but the current wave does not extract matched quantitative power gains and the research-loop transfer is indirect.
assessments.tested_scope: Adaptive conformal selection under ACS's information-control protocol.
corrections_or_limits: FDR validity does not imply downstream scientific utility or optimality.
Guarantees depend on the permitted information flow; leakage outside the protocol can invalidate them.
No exact effect-size or independent replication upgrade in this wave.

assessments.rationale: Peer-reviewed ICML/PMLR work establishes that some common fixed-confidence best-arm procedures can have positive-probability nontermination despite standard high-probability stopping analyses, and gives constructions with exponential-tailed stopping times.
assessments.tested_scope: Fixed-confidence best-arm identification with the paper's Sequential-Halving/doubling and generic wrapper assumptions.
corrections_or_limits: No numeric speedup ratio is claimed from the abstract-level crosscheck.
Wrapper overhead and correctness assumptions remain part of the contract.
Transfer to heterogeneous autonomous research units requires restartable state and a meaningful stopping-confidence contract.

assessments.rationale: A 100k-replicate worker simulation under an exact e-process-valid construction shows that maximizing deadline crossing probability can favor aggressive bets that materially worsen median/final log evidence. This cleanly separates validity from operational utility, but is a synthetic design study rather than an external benchmark result.
assessments.tested_scope: Independent paired-binary outer tasks under the stated stationary discordance/sign model and N<=50.
corrections_or_limits: Monte Carlo verifies behavior/power, not validity itself.
Do not generalize q=0.95 or any bettor choice as a universal default.
No external numerical replication.

assessments.rationale: Matched simulation shows strong horizon-dependent crossovers between fixed, predictable plug-in, prior-hedged and mixture e-process strategies; short budgets can penalize a naive plug-in that spends evidence learning the effect.
assessments.tested_scope: The worker's independent paired-binary simulation with its stated priors, mixture grid, discordance/effect regimes and 10-50 task horizons.
corrections_or_limits: Chosen prior center/strength and mixture grid are experiment-specific.
Supports calibration experiments, not one universal bettor.
No independent external replication.

assessments.rationale: The same simulation demonstrates that conditional median stopping time can rank high-variance methods misleadingly when unresolved paths are omitted, motivating joint reporting of resolution probability, discordance information and final evidence distribution.
assessments.tested_scope: Sequential paired benchmark reporting under the worker's e-process simulation and analogous settings.
corrections_or_limits: This is a reporting/measurement-validity recommendation, not a direct performance mechanism.
Exact fields require adaptation for nonbinary rewards.

assessments.rationale: Peer-reviewed defense-specific adaptive attacks drive multiple tested defenses from near-zero/low static ASR to very high ASR, directly demonstrating that generic/static attack evaluation can severely overstate robustness when the attacker is adapted to the defense.
assessments.tested_scope: The named 12 defenses and exact tested threat-model/attack adaptation conditions in Nasr et al., USENIX Security 2026.
corrections_or_limits: Do not infer the same ASR for untested deployments or defense variants.
Attacks are defense-adapted; this is not evidence that one universal attack transfers unchanged.
No family-level rejection follows from these tested configurations.

assessments.rationale: Peer-reviewed matched protocol evaluation shows adaptive prompt injection substantially eroding the tested trusted-monitor safety gain, and identifies a concrete least-suspicious resampling best-of-n evasion channel with a bounded alternative intervention.
assessments.tested_scope: APPS Backdooring/BashBench under the paper's attacker, monitor, threshold/budget and DTT/DTR protocol configurations.
corrections_or_limits: Do not generalize to monitor-independent control protocols.
The resampling failure is specific to the least-suspicious selection mechanism; max-suspiciousness changes that mechanism.
Keep safety numbers tied to the exact model/benchmark condition.

assessments.rationale: Large matched email-assistant experiments plus public code show a defensive fine-tuning configuration increasing delegated actions and reducing explicit attack recognition under contextual manipulation, with an adaptive attack and a relevant-history positive control.
assessments.tested_scope: The paper's email-assistant conditional-delegation scenarios, tested models, contextual manipulation and adaptive-attack setup.
corrections_or_limits: This is a threat-model shift and does not establish SecAlign is globally worse or invalidate its original threat model.
Public code is reproducibility support, not independent numerical replication.
Transfer numbers remain tied to the tested model versions.

assessments.rationale: The primary preprint reports large degradation in completion, timeout and latency under high interference, while explicitly changing multiple factors at once. It is valuable negative evidence about causal attribution and stage-wise measurement, not clean evidence for a decoy-only causal effect.
assessments.tested_scope: The exact none-versus-high-interference SysEvolve configurations and reported 50-case comparisons.
corrections_or_limits: Parallelism, decoys, topology hint and ordering change together.
Do not attribute the full degradation to decoys alone.
Preprint status and lack of a matched component factorial lower causal strength.

assessments.rationale: Hydra provides an unusually direct fixed-substrate rollback-policy comparison: checker, checkpoint interval, prompts and sampling are held fixed while rollback-node policies differ, and TokPol is reported to reduce latency/token use on 100 initially failing C++ tasks. However retry count/memory/update behavior is part of the policy and differs across baselines.
assessments.tested_scope: Qwen2.5-Coder-32B C++ compiler/static-error recovery on the Figure-7 rollback-policy experiment.
corrections_or_limits: Treat the causal object as the full rollback-selection policy, not a pure target-ranking rule.
Do not attribute Hydra's overall up-to-71% latency/up-to-70% token reductions to TokPol alone.
Exact Figure-7 raw samples/medians were not recovered in this wave.

assessments.rationale: Peer-reviewed UQD work with public code supplies direct archive-level corruption measurement through corrected archives/QD-score loss and matched sampling-budget comparisons showing naive elitism can amplify lucky evaluations; it also documents the exploration cost of brute-force resampling.
assessments.tested_scope: MAP-Elites-style uncertain QD on the paper's Arm/Hexapod/Walker/Ant domains and uncertainty models.
corrections_or_limits: Environmental/fitness/descriptor noise is not a semantic LLM judge with systematic bias.
Corrected-archive M=512 reevaluation is a measurement budget, not an online recommendation.
Aggregate QD-score loss does not itself distinguish false-admit from false-reject.

assessments.rationale: e-LOND and stopped e-BH provide strong formal evidence that online error budgets can be valid under broad dependence while also showing that locally anytime-valid processes do not automatically compose under globally adaptive stopping without appropriate filtration/causal conditions.
assessments.tested_scope: Online multiple testing/e-process streams under the respective theorem assumptions.
corrections_or_limits: No result here proves adaptively generated QD candidates satisfy the required filtration assumptions.
FDR control does not optimize search regret/diversity.
Archive-controller transfer remains a design hypothesis requiring a proof.

assessments.rationale: Public Loreley artifacts expose a deterministic eligibility rule and winner tie-breaks over 126 finalist groups, making a source-qualified false-admit/false-reject corruption replay exactly specifiable. The current wave proposes this experiment but does not execute it.
assessments.tested_scope: Loreley's released finalist formal records and deterministic validation_eligible/winner rule.
corrections_or_limits: No quantitative corruption-sweep outcome exists yet.
Synthetic eligibility flips are a decision-layer noise model, not raw metric hallucination.
Public artifacts omit full online generation/archive feedback trajectory.

assessments.rationale: Peer-reviewed source and official author code are established. The C7 worker independently reran released equations with a corrected hard-Hamming metric and fixed seeds: the proposed model reproduced a high-load/low-corruption advantage but was worse than both baselines across several K=200 mid/high corruption cells, while the public signed metric can cancel errors toward zero.
assessments.tested_scope: Official Model_comparison dynamics for sampled cells and the worker's 50-repetition K=200 n=1..10 corrected-Hamming sweep.
corrections_or_limits: This is a partial local reproduction, not the full published grid or an external independent replication.
No fixed author seed/raw Figure-4 matrices establish exact publication provenance.
Do not reject analytical fixed-point/Lyapunov/mechanism claims from this numerical discrepancy.

assessments.rationale: Current public Argus source and tests explicitly distinguish filesystem write containment from caller authentication: the repaired completion gate is described as a lock rather than a signature, and stage-machine caller identity is not cryptographically/capability authenticated. Primary verification corroborates this boundary.
assessments.tested_scope: Argus public commit 455da6c stage-machine and Engineer sandbox/source tests.
corrections_or_limits: No unauthorized live mutation was executed; this is source-level capability/reachability analysis.
Deployment configuration matters because safe mode is opt-in/default-off in the inspected source.
A host-only capability may exist outside the inspected public code and is not ruled out.

assessments.rationale: The newest primary audit verifies Table-4 values and that w/o CBR disables episodic memory, yet the no-CBR control itself rises 78.65 to 84.47 over iterations. The paper-era public artifacts do not identify the no-CBR inter-iteration operator/seeds/order/retry/cumulative accounting, so the shared upward slope is causally unidentified.
assessments.tested_scope: Memento DeepResearcher Table-4 iteration comparison in arXiv v2 and paper-era public artifact lineage.
corrections_or_limits: Same-iteration CBR separation can be used; do not attribute the common iteration slope to memory learning.
Later code must remain version-separated unless linked to the paper-era protocol.
No raw per-iteration manifest or independent reproduction is available.

assessments.rationale: OpenProver provides direct theorem-proving evidence for isolated parallel workers, compact shared state and selective external retrieval. On 185 ProofNet theorems with 100k output-token budgets, two model families improve substantially versus linear rollouts under the same output-token allowance.
assessments.tested_scope: ProofNet 185-theorem autonomous evaluation with Kimi-K2.5 and Leanstral and the paper's 100k-token setup.
corrections_or_limits: Same output tokens do not equal matched input tokens, wall-clock, parallelism or verifier/model-call cost.
Planner/worker/verifier scaffolding changes multiple components, so solve-rate gains are not attributable to context isolation or action selection alone.
No learned typed-controller ablation is present.

assessments.rationale: Peer-reviewed Rocket experiments show that a cheap fidelity can be executable yet too weak to guide optimization: the smallest ImageNet subsets had weak reward discrimination, while 1/128 crossed the paper's empirical adequacy diagnostics and improved full-data outcome. The study spans 30 independent experiments and broader 8-family/32-benchmark HPO evaluation.
assessments.tested_scope: Rocket's recurrent HPO tasks and the paper's normalized reward-standard-deviation proxy-adequacy diagnostics, especially the ImageNet subset study.
corrections_or_limits: The 0.2 reward-std and 0.1 decline thresholds are empirical defaults, not universal scientist-agent constants.
Final full-data performance is essential; proxy adequacy is domain-specific.
Author study evidence is strong but no independent scientist-agent two-fidelity replication is identified.

assessments.rationale: The reported representative development-workflow ablation remains meaningful primary evidence, but public implementation/score artifacts do not expose the raw temporal-ablation seeds/trajectories or exact GPT-5 reproduction command. An open issue requests missing configuration details.
assessments.tested_scope: The paper's representative R&D-Agent MLE-Bench temporal ablation and inspected public implementation/grading artifacts.
corrections_or_limits: Do not upgrade 34.7% versus 24.0% to independently reconstructed evidence.
One representative temporal ablation can combine multiple workflow changes.
Leaderboard grading reports do not identify the mechanism pathway.

assessments.rationale: Two released full AutoResearchEval trajectories provide direct source-qualified examples where severe self-critique is followed by disclosure/editing rather than an independent corrective rerun, sharpening the distinction between disclosure and repair.
assessments.tested_scope: The two specifically inspected released trajectories W4392129291 and W4394931502.
corrections_or_limits: Hand-selected n=2 examples cannot estimate population repair rate.
Do not infer official ARFT/F.4 labels from manual reconstruction.
Mechanism examples are useful for controller design but selection bias is substantial.

assessments.rationale: SkillBrew directly isolates edit-operation availability inside the same frozen-worker curation framework: adding Remove to Add+Rewrite improves ALFWorld by 5.5 points, WebShop score by 8.3 and success by 0.8 in the reported Table 5, while Table 4 separately shows diversity/coverage objectives are load-bearing.
assessments.tested_scope: SkillBrew's ALFWorld/WebShop Qwen2.5-7B curation framework and reported Table-4/Table-5 ablations.
corrections_or_limits: The ablation identifies value of Remove availability at bank level, not causal benefit of each individual deletion.
Query-set reuse across rounds leaves adaptive-overfitting/multiplicity exposure; no anytime-valid reusable-holdout guarantee is shown.
No clearly released official code or independent numerical reproduction identified in this wave.

summary.source_identity_rule: source-qualified/run-stable identity; never join audits or prior evidence by bare short id alone
summary.replication_rule: Author code, worker-local reruns, simulations, and same-paper artifacts strengthen reproducibility/failure scope but are not external independent numerical replication unless provenance-equivalent independent reruns exist.
material_high_strength: USENIX defense-adapted jailbreak/prompt-injection attacks and ICLR monitor-aware adaptive control attacks provide direct matched robustness failures.
UQD provides peer-reviewed archive-corruption diagnostics and matched-budget evidence that naive elitism amplifies lucky noise while brute-force resampling can starve exploration.
OpenProver supplies matched output-token system-level proof-search gains plus concrete context-isolation architecture.
Rocket supplies peer-reviewed multi-benchmark evidence that cheap-fidelity adequacy must be measured rather than assumed.
SkillBrew supplies a direct Remove-availability ablation inside a persistent skill-bank lifecycle.
The astrocyte-gated model now has official-code provenance plus a narrow corrected-metric reproduction that materially limits the broad numerical comparison.
material_holds_or_scope_corrections: DriftLens intended STL-10 mapping is recoverable, but exact UC8 author-embedding replay remains unavailable and chronological alarm performance is not established.
Hydra is evidence for a full rollback-selection policy, not a pure equal-retry target-ranking causal effect.
Loreley corruption replay is exactly specifiable but not yet executed.
Argus filesystem integrity is not authenticated transition capability; no live unauthorized mutation was demonstrated.
Memento's shared upward iteration slope remains causally unidentified because the no-CBR inter-iteration operator is missing.
R&D-Agent development ablation remains primary-study evidence without raw reproducible temporal traces/config.
AutoResearchEval disclosure-vs-repair evidence is mechanism-revealing n=2 manual reconstruction, not a population estimate.
